about:
Alaska Automotive operates in Palmer, Alaska, as a Napa Auto Care Center providing automotive repair and maintenance services. The business offers online quote requests and in-person service during weekday hours from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

The shop handles repair estimates based on vehicle year, make, model, and engine size, with VIN preferred but not mandatory. Customers can submit requests through the website and receive a reply via email, or call the office for a faster response. The company does not warranty parts supplied by customers or used parts of any kind, but it does offer a 24-month/24,000-mile parts and labor warranty on qualified parts through the Napa Auto Care "Peace of Mind" program, honored at 14,000 certified Napa Auto Care Centers nationwide.

The company serves individual vehicle owners and potentially commercial fleets seeking repair services, though specific customer segments are not detailed in available information.

Its affiliation with Napa Auto Care provides a differentiating warranty coverage that extends across the country, offering customers peace of mind when traveling beyond the local area.
